helm-values.description: Replaced by the values.yaml custom manager below, which reads tags that carry their digest (tag@sha256:...)

customManagers.description: Images in a chart's values.yaml: repository, then tag (comment lines between them allowed), optionally with its digest
A chart's appVersion, which follows the image named in its renovate comment: same depName, so same PR as the image

bumpVersions.description: Bump the chart's version with every update, as ct lint requires: minor for a major update, patch otherwise

packageRules.description: Automerge every non-major update, all ecosystems
Digest refreshes are rebuilds of an already-vetted tag
Skip the stability delay for base images and self-built images

OCI registries publish no release timestamp, so minimumReleaseAge can never be satisfied and internalChecksFilter=strict withholds the PR forever. docker.io (Hub API) is unaffected and keeps the 1 day delay
Majors always need a human; keep them off automerge
